summary: A caller the sekrets gateway refuses sees the gateway's reason instead of "Broken pipe" when the gateway closes before reading the request

schema.detail: No table, file, protocol or wire change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: When sending a request to the sekrets gateway fails, the client reads what the gateway already wrote and reports its refusal. With nothing to read it reports the send error as before. Refusals stay refusals.
